metadata.value: Technical terminology is summarized from the 2025 detailed Precision rules; game mechanics and game scoring are original design.
Required element shapes can change by competition year; keep rule versioning.

elements.base_requirements: Line: one or two balanced lines; Block: closed block with at least 3 lines; at least 20 m; no stopping; synchronized feature timing unless otherwise specified.
Line or block; at least 20 m; minimum 90° pivot; continuous pivoting in one rotational direction.
Circle or Wheel; all skaters rotate at least 360° in one direction or comparable distance when both directions are used.
All skaters participate in the construction; in 2025 Senior rules at least one skater is lifted and the lift remains for at least 3 seconds while moving.
Circle or Wheel; at least 360° rotation; travel is attempted, continuous and combined with rotation.
All skaters pass another skater; lines as equal as possible; no stopping.
All skaters attempt at least one free skating move; first move is evaluated once skaters attain position.
Closed block starting in 4 lines of 4 skaters; at least 20 m; no hold during the relevant features.

element_variants.name: Line
element_variants.description: One line or two lines as even as possible.

element_variants.name: Block
element_variants.description: Closed block with minimum three lines.

element_variants.name: Pivoting Line
element_variants.description: One or two parallel lines, minimum 90° pivot.

element_variants.name: Pivoting Block
element_variants.description: Closed block, minimum three lines, minimum 90° pivot.

element_variants.name: Circle
element_variants.description: Circle configuration; maximum three circles; at least four skaters in each circle.

element_variants.name: Wheel
element_variants.description: Wheel configuration; maximum three wheels; at least three skaters in each spoke.

element_variants.name: Lift
element_variants.description: Creative moving lift.

element_variants.name: Traveling Circle
element_variants.description: Rotating circle while translating across the floor.

element_variants.name: Traveling Wheel
element_variants.description: Rotating wheel while translating across the floor.

element_variants.name: Any Intersection
element_variants.description: Base intersection form.

element_variants.name: Two Line Intersection
element_variants.description: Two lines approach and intersect.

element_variants.name: L-Intersection
element_variants.description: L-shaped approach and intersection.

element_variants.name: Subsequent Intersection
element_variants.description: At least two subsequent intersections.

element_variants.name: V-Intersection
element_variants.description: Pivoting back-to-back entry.

element_variants.name: Box Intersection
element_variants.description: Collapsing box intersection.

element_variants.name: Triangle Intersection
element_variants.description: Collapsing triangle intersection.

element_variants.name: Whip Intersection
element_variants.description: Half-circle curved entry, pivot and unroll.

element_variants.name: Angled Intersection
element_variants.description: Parallel approach with a bounded corridor and controlled overlap.

element_variants.name: Simple Free Skating Move
element_variants.description: Simple FM group.

element_variants.name: Difficult Free Skating Move
element_variants.description: Difficult FM group.

element_variants.name: No Hold 4x4 Block
element_variants.description: Closed 4x4 block at entry, then no-hold features.

features.name: Different configurations
features.description: Change the number of lines/circles/spokes/centerpoints depending on element.

features.name: Change of place
features.description: All skaters/lines/spokes actively change places or positions.

features.name: Three different connected holds
features.description: Three distinct connected hold types where required.

features.name: Four different extra features
features.description: Four different extra features, with group-count limitations.

features.name: Change of rotational direction
features.description: At least half the team changes rotational direction.

features.name: Weaving
features.description: All skaters weave; at least twice; continuous sequence.

features.name: Interlocking
features.description: Circle: at least half interlock; Wheel: all spokes interlock.

features.name: Release of hold for 3 seconds
features.description: During release, skaters rotate/turn or use both directions.

features.name: Four turns/steps
features.description: Four-turn/step sequence; choice includes Choctaw, Rocker, Bracket.

features.name: Circular pattern
features.description: Block covers more than 270° in one rotational direction.

features.name: Two different axes
features.description: Use two distinct axes: long, short and/or diagonal.

features.name: Release of hold for 3 seconds
features.description: Release for three seconds with rotations or both directions.

features.name: Different FM types
features.description: At least two different one-foot FM types; each by at least four skaters.

features.name: Difficult entry
features.description: At least half the team executes a difficult entry.

features.name: Change of position
features.description: At least half the team changes position simultaneously under the hold/track constraints.

features.name: Intersecting / passing-through
features.description: At least half execute FM while intersecting/passing through.

features.name: Diagonal axis
features.description: At least two difficult turns on the same diagonal axis.

features.name: Pivoting
features.description: All skaters/lines pivot at least 90° with a body movement.

features.name: Two different configurations
features.description: Different number of lines; minimum three; not eight lines of two.

features.name: One-rotation jump
features.description: All skaters execute one rotation jump at the same time.

features.name: Change of relative position
features.description: In two shapes, one/both changes relative position; may orbit like a satellite.

features.name: Two continuous backward 360 rotations
features.description: Two backward 360° rotations in the same direction with no hold between.

features.name: Different element shape
features.description: Change from one shape to another with 360° in each shape.

features.name: Interlocking
features.description: Interlocking while rotating in opposite directions.

features.name: Intersecting (wheel)
features.description: At least half the team intersects at least once.

features.name: Weaving
features.description: Weaving in the rotating/traveling shape.

features.name: Body Movement bonus
features.description: Bonus extra feature at intersection point.

features.name: Free Skating Move bonus
features.description: Bonus extra feature at intersection point.

features.name: Backward Rotations bonus
features.description: At least one continuous 360° backward rotation through the intersection.

features.name: Traveling turn bonus
features.description: At least one traveling of two rotations.

features.name: Traveling + two turn types
features.description: Traveling plus two different turn types.

features.name: Traveling + three turn types
features.description: Traveling plus bracket, counter and rocker.

game_actions.name: Tap on beat
game_actions.description: Tap when the marker reaches the target window.

game_actions.name: Hold button
game_actions.description: Press and hold for the required duration.

game_actions.name: Double tap
game_actions.description: Double tap to trigger an advanced feature.

game_actions.name: Tap skater
game_actions.description: Tap a skater who drifts from the target position.

game_actions.name: Drag skater
game_actions.description: Drag a selected skater back toward the target track.

game_actions.name: Tap formation
game_actions.description: Choose the next formation before the timing window closes.

game_stats.name: Precision
game_stats.description: How closely the skater holds target track/position.

game_stats.name: Timing
game_stats.description: Ability to hit musical and formation timing windows.

game_stats.name: Speed
game_stats.description: Ability to reach and maintain target speed.

game_stats.name: Flow
game_stats.description: Smoothness of continuous movement and transitions.

game_stats.name: Balance
game_stats.description: Stability during turns and free skating moves.

game_stats.name: Synchronization
game_stats.description: Ability to match team timing and movement.

game_stats.name: Recovery
game_stats.description: How quickly the skater returns to target after an error.

scoring_categories.name: Technical
scoring_categories.description: Element type, level, features and successful execution.

scoring_categories.name: Quality of Execution
scoring_categories.description: Game analogue of QOE: spacing, unison, speed/flow and errors.

scoring_categories.name: Skating Skills
scoring_categories.description: Game analogue of edge control, flow, speed and precision.

scoring_categories.name: Choreography
scoring_categories.description: Purpose, pattern, floor coverage and musical structure.

scoring_categories.name: Penalties
scoring_categories.description: Falls, collisions, missed timing and rule breaches.
